freeze_stage: 2 of 2: recipe (stage 1, commit 43828c9) plus implementation and September parity; October challenger scoring is allowed only after this record is committed
role: challenger to H2/P021; H2/P021 remains the frozen primary (FREEZE.json, commit 3f705b2) and is not changed

recipe.h2_branch: unchanged H2 exactly as FREEZE.json policy (HGB on ordered 59-column F0, same training origins, labels, two-week half-life row weights)
recipe.pca_branch_preprocessing: continuous F0 columns -> sign(x)*log1p(|x|); binary columns (BINARY_COLUMNS) unchanged and must be 0/1; StandardScaler fitted on the training rows only; PCA(n_components=0.99, svd_solver='full', whiten=False) fitted on the scaled training rows only; uniform (unweighted) preprocessing
recipe.pca_branch_classifier: six independent LogisticRegression(C=1.0, solver='lbfgs', max_iter=2000, tol=1e-4, class_weight=None, random_state=42) fitted on PCA features with sample_weight = the H2 row-weight vector (mean 1); on ConvergenceWarning one retry with max_iter=4000; single-class target -> constant probability
recipe.refit: both branches and the PCA transform are refitted at every origin S from that origin's permitted training rows; no September model is reused
recipe.decision_score: 0.25*rank01(p_H2) + 0.25*rank01(p_WPCA) + 0.50*rank01(EW7 tau7d lookback90d), per target within the scored population, average-tie ranks; the model mixture is not reranked
recipe.k_rule: k_t = P_persist7 positive count for target t on the scored population (unchanged)
